description: Corporate graph centred on a company: parents and children (group structure from GLEIF) with counts and coverage notes. Only entities that pass the OpenMercantil identity policy appear, so an empty graph does not mean the company has no group.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company_graph
